subject: Close cadence & sequencing: MSA/DPA/order form dependencies for Novamedix
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@novamedix.com>, Novamedix Procurement <procurement@novamedix.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close cadence & sequencing: MSA/DPA/order form dependencies for Novamedix

Hi Elena / Novamedix procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. I’m attaching a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and our working MSA + DPA drafts so we can align sequencing and ownership up front. High-level constraints we observed on your side: data residency in EU + standard procurement PO flow for enterprise contracts.

Quick summary of the proposed sequencing (draft):
- Aug 5–10: Legal review window — MSA and DPA redlines (owner: Novamedix legal / Redwood legal)
- Aug 11–14: Redwood responds to redlines and submits final Annex A for DPA (owner: Redwood)
- Aug 15–18: Procurement approval & internal PO issuance (owner: Novamedix procurement)
- Aug 19–20: Signature — countersign/order form execution (owner: authorized signatories)
- Sep 1: Pilot go-live / evaluation start (onboarded model, 2-week eval cadence)

Ask: can you confirm your procurement PO cadence and any internal blackout dates in mid‑Aug that would affect the Aug 15–18 window? Also please flag any mandatory clauses besides data residency (e.g., audit, retention, KMS/SSO).

Attachments included: Redwood_MAP_Novamedix_v1.xlsx, MSA_Redwood_draft_20260805.pdf, DPA_Annex_A_requirements.docx (stubs).

I’ve cc’d Rishi (legal) so he can triage the DPA questions in parallel. If we can lock legal comments by Monday (Aug 10), I’ll push a final MAP update and coordinate PO sequencing with Laura for account ops.

Next steps:
- Elena / procurement: confirm PO timing + mandatory clause list by EOD Fri (Aug 7)
- Novamedix legal: share redline window expectations
- Redwood: finalize Annex A and provide redlineable MSA by Aug 11

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this quickly.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Elena Marquez <elena@novamedix.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamedix Procurement <procurement@novamedix.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence & sequencing: MSA/DPA/order form dependencies for Novamedix

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the clear MAP. We can move quickly but a few clarifications from procurement/legal before we commit to the dates:

1) DPA / Data residency: We require an EU data residency guarantee for all customer‑facing logs and a commitment on subprocessors. Is your Annex A modeled after standard EU SCCs + binding terms?
2) Retention & audit: We need retention caps (90/180 days) for logs and a clause to support vendor SSAE/SOC evidence requests.
3) KMS / encryption: Do you offer customer‑managed key (BYOK/KMS) or will Redwood retain the keys? Our security team prefers a KMS integration where feasible.
4) Signature: Our procurement requires a PO before countersignature for order forms above $50k — that could shift the signature target to Aug 20–24 depending on internal approvals.

We’ll get legal redline guidance to you by Monday Aug 10 but procurement needs a short appendix that lists which items are negotiable vs deal‑blocking.

Elena Marquez
Head of Platform & Partnerships | Novamedix
elena@novamedix.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@novamedix.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence & sequencing: MSA/DPA/order form dependencies for Novamedix

Elena — thanks for the questions. Quick notes from legal: we can accommodate most of the asks subject to the usual negotiation guardrails. Points below and proposed next steps.

- Data residency: Our standard Annex A supports EU data residency for customer logs and telemetry. We will provide a binding statement of data location for production workloads; draft language is in the attached Annex (DPA_Annex_A_requirements.docx).
- SCCs / legal basis: We can incorporate the EU SCCs or equivalent contractual protections; please flag if you require a specific module.
- Retention: We are generally comfortable with a 90–180 day log retention cap. Please indicate which signals you consider "logs" vs "processed outputs" so we map retention accurately.
- KMS: We support both Redwood‑managed encryption and customer KMS for select customers. If Novamedix requires BYOK, we’ll need the KMS onboarding checklist and a 2‑week ops window to validate key rotation and access controls before go‑live.
- Evidence: We can provide SOC-type evidence (summary and point of contact); full SOC reports will be shared under NDA if required.

Proposed timeline adjustment based on your PO requirement:
- Aug 10: Novamedix legal redlines (target)
- Aug 11–13: Redwood legal responds to redlines
- Aug 14–18: Procurement/PO process at Novamedix; Redwood to issue final order form immediately after PO
- Aug 20–24: Signature window (allowing for PO timing)

Action items:
- Novamedix: send redlines and the procurement appendix indicating deal‑blocking clauses by Aug 10 (agree to your earlier note)
- Redwood (Stephanie/Rishi): update MAP to show PO prerequisite before countersign and attach KMS onboarding checklist if BYOK is needed

If we get the redlines on Mon, we can still meet a late‑Aug signature and a Sep 1 pilot start.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Marquez <elena@novamedix.com>, Novamedix Procurement <procurement@novamedix.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence & sequencing: MSA/DPA/order form dependencies for Novamedix

Team — quick alignment note from the account lead perspective. We appreciate the clarity on the PO requirement. Two operational asks before I sign off on the MAP:

1) Stephanie — please update the MAP to reflect PO -> countersign dependency and add an optional contingency path if PO slips beyond Aug 24 (e.g., short term pilot waiver for limited dataset subject to DPA guardrails).
2) Rishi — please include the KMS onboarding checklist in the shared Drive link and a one‑pager for procurement describing what we need for BYOK (timing, contacts).

Once those two items are in, I’ll send Novamedix a single consolidated MAP + redline tracking packet and coordinate invoice terms with Finance. Our objective is to keep the signature window to Aug 20–28; if we see PO delay, we’ll propose phased acceptance to avoid a hard slip to Sep.

Stephanie — can you confirm you’ll circulate the updated MAP by EOD Wed (Aug 11)? Elena — thanks in advance for the procurement appendix on deal blockers.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
